products.name: VelociVoice
products.description: All-in-one vocal plugin: tuning, compressor, saturation, doubler, delay and reverb. Load a preset, hit record, sound finished.
longDescription: Stop stacking 6 plugins on your vocal. VelociVoice puts everything your voice needs in one plugin, made to record yourself and sound finished from the first take.
Load it on your vocal track, pick a preset and record: you hear yourself with tuning, compression and effects in real time, with only about 4 ms of delay.

os: macOS 11 Big Sur or later (Intel & Apple Silicon M1–M4)

features: RaptorTune built in: one wheel from natural to hard robot tuning, plus XTREME
Compressor with automatic de-esser
Saturation, from warm to distorted
Modulation: doubler, chorus or flanger
Delay synced to your tempo (1/4, 1/8, 1/8 dotted, 1/16)
Reverb: room, plate or hall
12 presets: 4 lead, 4 backing, 4 adlib, all level-matched
About 4 ms of latency: record while you hear yourself with the effect
Safety limiter: it never clips
products.license: One license = up to 2 computers. Internet needed only once, to activate.
notes: Mac: the installer is not notarized yet. If macOS blocks it, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
products.seoTitle: VelociVoice — All-in-one vocal chain plugin for home recording (VST3 / AU)
products.seoDescription: VelociVoice is a vocal chain plugin for recording at home: tuning, compression with de-esser, saturation, doubler, delay and reverb in one plugin, with 12 presets and about 4 ms of latency. VST3 for Windows, VST3 & AU for Mac.

faq.a: No. Set the key and scale of your song, pick a LEAD, BACKING or ADLIB preset and record. The 12 presets already include tuning, compression, saturation, delay and reverb. Your DAW keeps the clean voice, so you can change the preset later.
Any DAW that loads VST3 plugins on Windows, and VST3 or AU on Mac. It works in Logic Pro, GarageBand, Ableton Live, FL Studio, Cubase, Studio One, Reaper and Bitwig.

faq.q: Can I hear the effects while recording?
faq.a: Yes. VelociVoice runs with about 4 ms of latency, so you can monitor your voice with the effect while you record.
It's built for people who don't mix: choose a preset, adjust a few big controls if you want, and record. An input meter tells you if your mic is too loud, and a safety limiter keeps it from clipping.

Yes. VelociVoice Lite is the complete plugin with every feature and all 12 presets. The only limit is 1 second of silence every 45 seconds. Paste your license key and the silence disappears, no reinstall needed.

faq.q: Is it compatible with Windows and Mac?
faq.a: Yes. Windows 10/11 (64-bit) as VST3, and macOS 11 Big Sur or later on Intel and Apple Silicon (M1–M4) as VST3 and AU. The Mac installer is not notarized yet: if macOS blocks it, go to System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway.
No. It's a one-time purchase on Gumroad. One license works on up to 2 computers, and you only need internet once, to activate.

products.name: STOMPOSAURUS
products.tagline: The T-Rex clipper for kicks, 808s & drum buses.
products.description: Clipper for louder kicks, 808s and drum buses. Every hit it clips, the T-Rex stomps — and the sub stays untouched.
longDescription: STOMPOSAURUS is a clipper made for modern trap, drill and hip-hop drums. Push your drums into the ceiling and get serious loudness and punch, while Sub Armor keeps the low end clean. Only the punch gets stomped, and that's what people hear on phones and laptops.
Every hit that actually gets clipped, a T-Rex foot stomps it on screen. You see exactly what the clipper is doing.
features: STOMP: drive up to +18 dB into the ceiling
SHAPE: from Bronto (soft, round) to Raptor (hard, aggressive)
CEILING: set your maximum output from -12 to 0 dBFS
SUB ARMOR + ARMOR LINE: everything below the line (30–150 Hz) passes clean
MIX: parallel clipping, from dry to fully stomped
NO CHEATING: level-matched comparison, judge the sound and not the volume
HARD CEILING: the output never goes above your ceiling
4x oversampling on all clipping, light on CPU
11 factory presets for kick, 808, drums and master — save your own
Resizable dark fantasy interface (75–150 %)
products.license: One license, up to 2 computers. Everything you make with it is 100 % yours, royalty-free. Early access (v0.9): free updates for buyers.

products.name: STEGOBURN
products.description: Saturator for trap, drill and R&B. Make your 808 hit on every speaker — without wrecking the sub.
longDescription: STEGOBURN is a saturator built for trap, drill and R&B. Turn up RAGE and the stegosaurus wakes up, gets angry and finally bursts into flames, while your 808 grows the harmonics that make it audible on phones, laptops and earbuds.
features: RAGE: how hard it burns
LEASH: dry/wet blend for parallel saturation
Three moods: PURR (warm tape), GROWL (tube bite), ROAR (hard clip)
SUB ARMOR: everything below the ARMOR LINE (40–250 Hz) stays clean
NO CHEATING: automatic gain matching
SPARKLE (tone) and LOUDNESS (output) secret settings
4x linear-phase oversampling for clean, alias-free distortion
Under 1 ms latency — safe for tracking, low CPU
13 presets for 808s, vocals, drums and mix bus
products.license: Your license key activates STEGOBURN on up to 2 computers. Without activation it runs in demo mode (a short silence every 45 seconds).

products.name: RaptorTune
products.tagline: Hard, modern vocal tuning. One wheel.
products.description: Hard, modern vocal tuning with one big wheel. From natural correction to the robotic trap sound, plus XTREME mode.
longDescription: RaptorTune snaps your vocal to the key of your song. Turn one big wheel from NATURAL (gentle correction) to ROBOT (the hard, modern sound), and push XTREME when ROBOT is not enough.

os: macOS 11 Big Sur or later (Intel & Apple Silicon M1–M4)

features: One big wheel: NATURAL to ROBOT
XTREME mode: drier note jumps, metallic tone, glitchy note changes
Key & scale: set it once and it follows the song
Live note display: see the note you sing and where it lands
Formant: make the voice darker or brighter
Humanize & Flex: keep slides and vibrato natural when you want
Clean lows: no boomy bass on deep voices
Voice range (low / mid / high) and mix control
products.license: One license = up to 2 computers. Internet needed only once to activate.
